title: Find the Nth root of a number using binary search
pattern: binary search on the answer with overflow guard
problemStatement: Find the integer m with m^n = x, or -1 if none exists.
intuition: m^n is monotone in m. The practical catch is that m^n explodes, so compute the power with early termination once it exceeds x.

approaches.title: Optimal: binary search with capped power
approaches.idea: Stop multiplying as soon as the product passes x.
approaches.whyWorks: Capping the power keeps intermediate values bounded while preserving the comparison result.

commonMistakes: Using floating point and getting off-by-one roots
patternRecognition: Monotone function + comparison helper = binary search on the answer
followUps: Real-valued nth root to precision eps
Handle negative x with odd n
interviewInsight: The early-exit power helper is the detail interviewers wait for.
